steps.wording: I should assert that the element with id {string} contains {string}
steps.meaning: The text of the first element with this test id contains the value.
steps.example: I should assert that the element with id "day-length-label" contains "Full day"

steps.wording: I should assert that the element with id {string} has an exact value of {string}
steps.meaning: The text of the first element with this test id is exactly the value.
steps.example: I should assert that the element with id "ages-label" has an exact value of "5-17 years old"

steps.wording: I should assert that the element with id {string} is of type {string}
steps.meaning: The one element with this test id has this tag name (for example "a" or "button").
steps.example: I should assert that the element with id "map-marker-card-directions-link" is of type "a"

steps.wording: I should assert that the element with id {string} has an attribute {string} with value {string}
steps.meaning: The one element with this test id has the attribute set to exactly the value.
steps.example: I should assert that the element with id "map-view-component" has an attribute "data-map-zoom" with value "6"

steps.wording: I should assert that the {string} element {string} visible
steps.meaning: With "is_visible", the one element with this test id becomes visible; with "is_not_visible", none is visible.
steps.example: I should assert that the "favorite-icon-camp-id-0" element "is_visible" visible

steps.wording: I click on the element with id {string}
steps.meaning: Clicks the one element with this test id, once it is visible.
steps.example: I click on the element with id "user-location-button"

steps.wording: I click on the element which has an attribute {string} with value {string}
steps.meaning: Clicks the one element whose attribute has exactly this value, once it is visible.
steps.example: I click on the element which has an attribute "aria-label" with value "Zoom in"

steps.wording: I {string} over the element with id {string}
steps.meaning: With "hover" or "click", hovers or clicks the one element with this test id, then lets the UI settle.
steps.example: I "hover" over the element with id "combinable-camp-id-0-label"

steps.meaning: Pauses for the given number of seconds.

discouraged.reason: A fixed sleep hides timing bugs and slows every run; a step that checks the page waits for it on its own.

steps.wording: I {string} geolocation and set the location to {string}, {string}
steps.meaning: With "allow", the page's location requests get the given location; with "deny", they fail as when the visitor blocks them.
steps.example: I "allow" geolocation and set the location to "51.50", "-0.12"
